entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: Natural event that reunited the Shards of Alara into a single plane.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker who sought the Conflux's mana to restore his power.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Leonin planeswalker who conjured an echo of Bolas to drive him off.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: Slumbering hydra-god awakened by the merging.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: Vortex of unstable energy created at the nexus of the merging shards.

entities.name: Gwafa Hazid
entities.description: Agent of Bolas who unearthed the Obelisk of Bant.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: Agent of Bolas who revealed the Obelisk of Jund.

events.summary: Bolas's agents reveal the obelisks one by one through sabotage and deception.
events.quote: Bolas's agents revealed the plane's obelisks one by one through sabotage and deception

events.summary: The shards merge, creating the Maelstrom and awakening Progenitus.
events.quote: It also reawakened the slumbering hydra-god Progenitus

events.summary: Ajani conjures a spiritual echo of Bolas that attacks him and forces him to retreat from Alara.
events.quote: This magical duplicate attacked Bolas and forced the elder dragon to retreat from Alara.

relations.note: Ajani intervened as Bolas absorbed the Maelstrom's mana.
relations.quote: the leonin planeswalker Ajani Goldmane intervened
